------ selectBookingOccupancyDetails {{ select HBDD.*
, case when room_booking_date <= greatest(departure_date - 1, arrival_date) then BTC._deduct_yn else null end as _deduct_yn
, case when (case when HBB.arrival_date != HBB.departure_date then HBB.departure_date != HBDD.room_booking_date else DAY_USE._is_occ_day_use end) then 'Y' else 'N' end as _occupied_yn , case when HBB.arrival_date = HBB.departure_date then 'Y' else 'N' end as _day_use_yn , case when HBB.arrival_date = HBDD.room_booking_date then 'Y' else 'N' end as _due_in_yn , case when HBB.departure_date = HBDD.room_booking_date then 'Y' else 'N' end as _due_out_yn , case when HBB.departure_date != HBDD.room_booking_date or HBB.arrival_date = HBB.departure_date then 'Y' else 'N' end as _in_house_yn , coalesce(adult_count, 0) + coalesce(child_count, 0) as _person_count
from hpms.hpbk_booking_daily_detail HBDD join hpms.hpbk_booking_basic HBB on HBB.chain_id = HBDD.chain_id and HBB.property_id = HBDD.property_id and HBB.booking_seq = HBDD.booking_seq join hpms.hpbk_room_type_code RTC on HBDD.chain_id = RTC.chain_id and HBDD.property_id = RTC.property_id and HBDD.room_type_code = RTC.room_type_code and RTC.pseudo_room_type_yn != 'Y'
left join ( select *, coalesce(setting_value, 'N') = 'Y' as _is_occ_day_use from fwcm.fwcm_property_setting where property_setting_code = 'HPBK_DAY_USE_IS_COUNTED_IN_OCC_YN' ) DAY_USE on DAY_USE.chain_id = HBDD.chain_id and DAY_USE.property_id = HBDD.property_id
left join ( select *, coalesce(cd.reference_character_value1, 'N') as _deduct_yn from fwcm.fwcm_cd_detail cd where cd.common_cd = 'BOOKING_TYPE_CD' ) BTC on BTC.chain_id = HBDD.chain_id and BTC.property_id = HBDD.property_id and BTC.detail_cd = HBB.booking_type_cd
where true and HBB.booking_status_cd in ('BOOKED','CHECKED_IN','CHECKED_OUT')
and HBDD.room_booking_date between HBB.arrival_date and GREATEST(HBB.departure_date - 1, HBB.arrival_date)
and HBDD.room_booking_date between HBB.arrival_date and HBB.departure_date
------ }} selectBookingOccupancyDetails

------ selectBlockBasic_withDeductInfo {{ select HBLB.* , HBLSC._deduct_yn from hpms.hpbk_block_basic HBLB left join ( select HBLSC.* , case when RSTC.reference_character_value1 = 'DEDUCT' then 'Y' else 'N' end as _deduct_yn from hpms.hpbk_block_status_code HBLSC join fwcm.fwcm_cd_detail RSTC on RSTC.chain_id = '00000' and RSTC.property_id = '00000' and RSTC.common_cd = 'ROOM_STATUS_TYPE_CD' and RSTC.reference_character_value1 in ('DEDUCT', 'NON-DEDUCT') where RSTC.detail_cd = HBLSC.room_status_type_cd ) HBLSC on HBLB.chain_id = HBLSC.chain_id and HBLB.property_id = HBLSC.property_id and HBLB.block_status_cd = HBLSC.block_status_code where HBLB.inactive_yn = 'N' ------ }} selectBlockBasic_withDeductInfo

------ selectRoomOoo_withTypes {{ select HRO.*, HRB.room_type_code from hpms.hphk_room_ooo HRO , hpms.hpbk_room_basic HRB where HRO.inactive_yn = 'N' and HRO.ooo_status_cd in ('OUT OF ORDER', 'OUT OF SERVICE') and HRO.chain_id = HRB.chain_id and HRO.property_id = HRB.property_id and HRO.room_no = HRB.room_no ------ }} selectRoomOoo_withTypes

------ selectPhysicalRoomTypes_withCount {{ select RTC.* , (select count(*) as _room_count from hpms.hpbk_room_basic HRB where HRB.chain_id = RTC.chain_id and HRB.property_id = RTC.property_id and HRB.room_type_code = RTC.room_type_code) as _room_count from hpms.hpbk_room_type_code RTC where RTC.inactive_yn = 'N' and RTC.pseudo_room_type_yn != 'Y' ------ }} selectPhysicalRoomTypes_withCount

------ selectWaitingStatistics_daily {{ select HBDD.chain_id, HBDD.property_id, HBDD.room_booking_date, HBDD.room_type_code , count(*) as waiting , sum(coalesce(HBDD.child_count, 0) + coalesce(HBDD.adult_count, 0)) as waiting_person from hpms.hpbk_booking_daily_detail HBDD cross join hpms.hpbk_booking_basic HBB cross join _statistic_options _opt where true and HBB.chain_id = HBDD.chain_id and HBB.property_id = HBDD.property_id and HBB.booking_seq = HBDD.booking_seq and HBB.booking_status_cd in ('WAITING') and (HBB.departure_date > HBDD.room_booking_date or HBB.arrival_date = HBDD.room_booking_date) and HBDD.chain_id = _opt.chainId and HBDD.property_id = _opt.propertyId group by HBDD.chain_id, HBDD.property_id, HBDD.room_booking_date, HBDD.room_type_code ------ }} selectWaitingStatistics_daily

------ selectAvailabilityOccupancyStatistic_daily {{
select rs.*
, inventory_rooms + overbooking as sell_limits
, inventory_rooms - deducted_sum as house_availability
, inventory_rooms - deducted_sum + overbooking as max_availability
, inventory_rooms - deducted_sum + overbooking - non_deducted_sum as min_availability
, deducted_sum as min_occupancy
, deducted_sum + non_deducted_sum as max_occupancy from ( with inventory as (
)
, bk as (
)
, bk_waiting as (
)
, bl as (
)
, room_type_sum as ( select rm.chain_id, rm.property_id, rm.date , rm.room_class_code, rm.room_type_code, rm.display_seq , 'ROOM_TYPE' as _grouping_type
, 0 as overbooking
, coalesce(ov_rt.overbooking_count, 0) as overbooking
, coalesce(rm._room_count, 0) as physical_room , coalesce(bk.deduct, 0) as booking_deduct , coalesce(bk.non_deduct, 0) as booking_non_deduct
, coalesce(bk.arrival, 0) as arrival , coalesce(bk.departure, 0) as departure , coalesce(bk.day_use, 0) as day_use , coalesce(bk_waiting.waiting, 0) as waiting , coalesce(bk.arrival_person, 0) as arrival_person , coalesce(bk.departure_person, 0) as departure_person , coalesce(bk.day_use_person, 0) as day_use_person , coalesce(bk_waiting.waiting_person, 0) as waiting_person , coalesce(bk.adult_in_house, 0) as adult_in_house , coalesce(bk.child_in_house, 0) as child_in_house
, coalesce(rm.ooo, 0) as ooo , coalesce(rm.oos, 0) as oos , coalesce(bl.deduct, 0) as block_deduct , coalesce(bl.non_deduct, 0) as block_non_deduct , coalesce(bl.deduct_pickup, 0) as block_deduct_pickup , coalesce(bl.non_deduct_pickup, 0) as block_non_deduct_pickup , coalesce(bl.deduct, 0) - coalesce(bl.deduct_pickup, 0) + coalesce(bk.deduct, 0) as deducted_sum , coalesce(bl.non_deduct, 0) - coalesce(bl.non_deduct_pickup, 0) + coalesce(bk.non_deduct, 0) as non_deducted_sum , rm._room_count - coalesce(rm.ooo, 0) as inventory_rooms
from inventory rm left join bl on rm.chain_id = bl.chain_id and rm.property_id = bl.property_id and rm.room_type_code = bl.room_type_code and rm.date = bl.block_date
left join bk on rm.chain_id = bk.chain_id and rm.property_id = bk.property_id and rm.room_type_code = bk.room_type_code and rm.date = bk.room_booking_date
left join bk_waiting on rm.chain_id = bk_waiting.chain_id and rm.property_id = bk_waiting.property_id and rm.room_type_code = bk_waiting.room_type_code and rm.date = bk_waiting.room_booking_date
left join lateral ( select * from hpms.hpbk_overbooking_list ov_rt where rm.chain_id = ov_rt.chain_id and rm.property_id = ov_rt.property_id and rm.date = ov_rt.sell_limit_room_date and rm.room_type_code = ov_rt.room_type_code limit 1 ) ov_rt on true
cross join _statistic_options _opt where rm.chain_id = _opt.chainId and rm.property_id = _opt.propertyId )
, room_class_sum as ( select rs.chain_id, rs.property_id, rs.date , rs.room_class_code as room_class_code , null::text as room_type_code , null::numeric as display_seq , 'ROOM_CLASS' as _grouping_type
, 0 as overbooking
, coalesce(max(ov_rc.overbooking_count), sum(rs.overbooking)) as overbooking
, sum(physical_room) as physical_room , sum(booking_deduct) as booking_deduct , sum(booking_non_deduct) as booking_non_deduct
, sum(arrival) as arrival , sum(departure) as departure , sum(day_use) as day_use , sum(waiting) as waiting , sum(arrival_person) as arrival_person , sum(departure_person) as departure_person , sum(day_use_person) as day_use_person , sum(waiting_person) as waiting_person , sum(adult_in_house) as adult_in_house , sum(child_in_house) as child_in_house
, sum(ooo) as ooo , sum(oos) as oos , sum(block_deduct) as block_deduct , sum(block_non_deduct) as block_non_deduct , sum(block_deduct_pickup) as block_deduct_pickup , sum(block_non_deduct_pickup) as block_non_deduct_pickup , sum(deducted_sum) as deducted_sum , sum(non_deducted_sum) as non_deducted_sum , sum(inventory_rooms) as inventory_rooms from room_type_sum rs
left join lateral ( select * from hpms.hpbk_overbooking_list ov_rc where ov_rc.room_type_code is null and rs.room_class_code = ov_rc.room_class_code and rs.date = ov_rc.sell_limit_room_date limit 1 ) ov_rc on true
group by rs.chain_id, rs.property_id, rs.date , rs.room_class_code )
, daily_summary as ( select rs.chain_id, rs.property_id, rs.date , null::text as room_class_code , null::text as room_type_code , null::int as display_seq , case when grouping(_selected) != 0 then 'DAILY_SUM' when _selected then 'SELECTED' else 'NOT_SELECTED' end as _grouping_type , sum(overbooking) as overbooking , sum(physical_room) as physical_room , sum(booking_deduct) as booking_deduct , sum(booking_non_deduct) as booking_non_deduct
, sum(arrival) as arrival , sum(departure) as departure , sum(day_use) as day_use , sum(waiting) as waiting , sum(arrival_person) as arrival_person , sum(departure_person) as departure_person , sum(day_use_person) as day_use_person , sum(waiting_person) as waiting_person , sum(adult_in_house) as adult_in_house , sum(child_in_house) as child_in_house
, sum(ooo) as ooo , sum(oos) as oos , sum(block_deduct) as block_deduct , sum(block_non_deduct) as block_non_deduct , sum(block_deduct_pickup) as block_deduct_pickup , sum(block_non_deduct_pickup) as block_non_deduct_pickup , sum(deducted_sum) as deducted_sum , sum(non_deducted_sum) as non_deducted_sum , sum(inventory_rooms) as inventory_rooms from room_class_sum rs cross join _statistic_options _opt left join (select true as _selected) sct on array_length(_opt.roomClasses, 1) is null or rs.room_class_code = any(_opt.roomClasses) group by grouping sets ( (rs.chain_id, rs.property_id, date, _selected) , (rs.chain_id, rs.property_id, date) ) )
select * from room_type_sum
union all select * from room_class_sum
union all select * from daily_summary
) rs ------ }} selectAvailabilityOccupancyStatistic_daily
